item.description:
Sunday, November 15th, 2:00p – 5:00p | $15 Cover Fringe Revival is an Asheville, NC-based psychedelic rock tribute band bringing the sound, spirit, and energy of the Psychedelic Rock Era (1966–1970) to life. With a powerful, authentic approach, the band delivers faithful renditions of the era’s most memorable songs while shining a light on some of its rarely performed gems. From Steppenwolf and Cream to The Doors and beyond, Fringe Revival’s spirited performances transport audiences back to a defining chapter in music history. Their carefully curated repertoire captures the raw energy, adventurous musicianship, and unmistakable sound of the late ’60s psychedelic rock movement—celebrating the music that helped define a generation. https://fringerevival.com/

item.title: Daniel Ridge: 7-8 miles, 1700' elevation gain — Wed Nov 18, 8:45 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This will be a modified version of the Daniel Ridge loop due to FS 475 being closed between Cove Creek and Daniel Ridge.
We'll meet at the Ranger Station middle parking lot at 8:15 for a 9:00 sharp departure. Carpool to the Cove Creek parking area on FS475.
From the parking, we'll walk about .5 mile up FS608 towards the Cove Creek Campgrounds. From the road we'll take the Caney Bottom trail to the Old Lanning Ridge trail over to FS5046. Left on FS5046 down to Daniel Ridge waterfall (also called Tom's Springs waterfall and Jackson Falls). On to the Daniel Ridge trail to start the loop. On way we will hit FS5046 again and head over to Upper Tom's Springs fall and back to Old Landing Ridge trail and to the cars.
Distance: around 7-8 miles Elevation gain: 1700 Difficulty: moderate.
Dogs are welcome. I will have my dog with me.
If you prefer to meet at the trailhead please let me know in the comments.
Source: Asheville Hiking Group

item.title: Bald Rock Preserve; a Saunter — Sat Nov 21, 9:45 AM
item.description: Hendo Fun Friends The Bald Rock is a large overlook viewing the Piedmont of SC. The preserve contains a complex of granite outcrops, seeps and waterslides surrounded by a mosaic of mixed pines and hardwoods. Lichens and mosses have colonized portions of the rock outcrops. Joined with forces of weather, these pioneer species create pockets and cracks in the granite, which are filled with sand and organic matter. I am going to the ***NEW*** Bald Rock Preserve south of Caesarhead Pk on Hwy 276; Up to 12 ppl are welcome to join me. Remember - hikes led by ‘the Curmudgeon’ tend to have pleasant surprises. We are the Sloth Hiking Group: “We will get there when we get there.” We dare to go where the ‘real’ hike groups don’t ***!!*** **John Muir didn’t like the word ‘hike’. *“We ought to saunter through them reverently, not 'hike' through them.”*** **Details:** Hike Distance: 1.5 mi RT In&out; Accum ascent: 200 ft; Pace: **1.5mph** Difficulty: New trail built recently. item.title: Gaming Night @ Noble Cider — Tue Dec 8, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville's Bored Game Geeks Roll the dice and pour a glass! 🎲🍎
Gaming Night is back at Noble Cider! Join us every other Tuesday for a night of tabletop tactics, card-shuffling chaos, and great company. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or you still think a "meeple" is a type of small fruit, you’re welcome at our table.
### The Lowdown:
* **No Experience? No Problem:** We’re all about community. We’ll help you learn the ropes of a new game or cheer you on while you figure it out. * **The Library:** We have a solid stash of games ready to play—from quick party favorites to deeper strategy titles. * **Bring Your Favorites:** Have a game gathering dust on your shelf? Bring it along! We love seeing what the community is playing. * **The Vibe:** High-quality cider, cozy atmosphere, and just the right amount of competitive spirit.
**Feel Free to bring your own games too!**

item.title: Exhibition on Screen | Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers — Sun Dec 27, 2:00 PM — Asheville Art Museum
item.description: Two hundred years after its opening and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh artworks, the National Gallery, London is hosting the United Kingdom’s biggest ever Van Gogh exhibition. Van Gogh is not only one of the most beloved artists of all time, but perhaps the most misunderstood. This film is a chance to reexamine and better understand this iconic artist. Focusing on his unique creative process, Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers explores the artist’s years in the south of France, where he revolutionized his style. Van Gogh became consumed with a passion for storytelling in his art, turning the world around him into vibrant, idealized spaces and symbolic characters. Poets and lovers filled his imagination; everything he did in the south of France served this new obsession. In part, this is what caused his notorious breakdown, but it didn’t hold back his creativity as he created masterpiece after masterpiece. Explore one of art history’s most pivotal periods in this once-in-a-century
